_note: Verb-imperative homographs with BOTH readings, for mine_homographs.py. Each verb's imperative (final stress) collides with a root-stressed non-imperative form of the same verb; a context-aware model learns the boundary only from CORRECT labels of BOTH readings. 'imp' = imperative (final), 'sg3' = 3sg present (imperfectives) or aorist 3sg (perfectives) — both root-stressed. Marks are DB-verified. 'perfective' lists verbs whose imperative is a clean immediate command (so a clause-initial '!' in short dialogue is reliably imperative); imperfective imperatives are durative and surface-identical to the indignant/habitual 3sg exclamation, so they are mined ONLY via the particle cue. Native-verified 2026-07-07. Excludes the 15 always-final verbs (not homographs) and semantic homographs чета/прости.
